operations.name: dluma.log
operations.documentation: Writes a bounded owner-attributed message to the loader log.

operations.name: dluma.capability
operations.documentation: Queries configured support and current readiness for one stable capability ID.

operations.name: dluma.clock.monotonic_ms
operations.documentation: Returns the loader monotonic clock in milliseconds.

operations.name: dluma.timer.after
operations.documentation: Schedules one owner-bound callback after a positive delay.

operations.name: dluma.timer.every
operations.documentation: Schedules one repeating owner-bound callback.

operations.name: mod:off
operations.documentation: Idempotently cancels an owner-bound timer, subscription, callback, or resource token.

operations.name: dluma.world.find
operations.documentation: Finds an exact runtime object name and returns an opaque owner- and generation-bound handle.

operations.name: object:position
operations.documentation: Returns a copied object position after ownership, identity, and generation revalidation.

operations.name: object:forward_direction
operations.documentation: Returns a copied normalized object forward direction.

operations.name: object:is_enabled
operations.documentation: Returns the copied local-enable state for an opaque object handle.

operations.name: dluma.world.set_enabled_many
operations.documentation: Applies a bounded local-enable change to exact object names.

operations.name: dluma.player.local_player
operations.documentation: Returns the opaque generation-bound local-player handle.

operations.name: player:position
operations.documentation: Returns a copied local-player position.

operations.name: player:look_direction
operations.documentation: Returns a copied normalized local-player look direction.

operations.name: player:body_direction
operations.documentation: Returns a copied normalized local-player body direction.

operations.name: player:health
operations.documentation: Returns copied current local-player health.

operations.name: player:max_health
operations.documentation: Returns computed maximum local-player health when an independently validated PlayerDI vitals binding is ready; this is never substituted with a raw PlayerVariable.

operations.name: player:is_alive
operations.documentation: Returns the validated local-player alive state.

operations.name: dluma.player.variable_names
operations.documentation: Lists the generated allowlist of named PlayerVariables.

operations.name: player:variable
operations.documentation: Reads one copied allowlisted raw PlayerVariables tuning snapshot. Names such as max_health and base_max_health are not current health or the computed PlayerDI maximum-health result.

operations.name: player:set_variable
operations.documentation: Transactionally applies one bounded transient allowlisted raw PlayerVariables tuning override; invalid or non-finite derived values leave game memory unchanged.

operations.name: player:reset_variable
operations.documentation: Restores one transient PlayerVariables override owned by the mod.

operations.name: dluma.player.vehicle_state
operations.documentation: Returns copied local-player vehicle state without exposing an engine pointer.

operations.name: mod:on_update
operations.documentation: Subscribes a callback to the bounded game-thread frame dispatcher.

operations.name: dluma.events.sensor.is_inside
operations.documentation: Returns whether the local player is inside an exact named SensorArea.

operations.name: mod:on_sensor_enter
operations.documentation: Subscribes to deduplicated enter edges for one exact named SensorArea.

operations.name: mod:on_sensor_leave
operations.documentation: Subscribes to deduplicated leave edges for one exact named SensorArea.

operations.name: mod:on_interact_begin
operations.documentation: Subscribes to successful base InteractiveItem trigger observations.

operations.name: mod:on_enemy_killed
operations.documentation: Reserved copied post-death event; unavailable until its exact observer is validated.

operations.name: dluma.ui.send_subtitle
operations.documentation: Shows a bounded loader-owned subtitle.

operations.name: dluma.ui.update_subtitle
operations.documentation: Updates the active loader-owned subtitle.

operations.name: dluma.ui.quest_hud
operations.documentation: Returns a bounded copied view of the current quest HUD.

operations.name: dluma.ui.override_quest_hud
operations.documentation: Creates or updates one presentation-only quest HUD override.

operations.name: dluma.ui.toast
operations.documentation: Reserved loader-overlay toast operation.

operations.name: dluma.audio.play_radio_dialog
operations.documentation: Starts one exact named dialog speaker group.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.play
operations.documentation: Starts one owner-bound allowlisted cue from an opened companion bank.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.stop
operations.documentation: Stops one owner-bound companion cue with an optional bounded fade.

operations.name: dluma.audio.bank.open
operations.documentation: Opens one manifest-allowlisted CSB bank from an approved companion archive.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.duration
operations.documentation: Returns the probed millisecond duration of one allowlisted cue.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.state
operations.documentation: Returns copied playback state for one owner-bound cue.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.seek
operations.documentation: Seeks one owner-bound cue to a bounded millisecond position.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.set_gain
operations.documentation: Sets bounded gain for one owner-bound cue.

operations.name: dluma.audio.cue.set_filter
operations.documentation: Sets exact-build filter values for one owner-bound cue.

operations.name: dluma.audio.music.acquire
operations.documentation: Acquires process-exclusive stock-music ownership transactionally.

operations.name: dluma.audio.music.state
operations.documentation: Returns the current phase of an owner-bound exclusive music lease.

operations.name: dluma.audio.music.set_filter
operations.documentation: Sets restorable exact-build filter values for an exclusive stock-music lease.

operations.name: dluma.audio.music.release
operations.documentation: Restores and releases an exclusive stock-music lease with bounded delayed resume.

operations.name: dluma.quests.advance_to_phase
operations.documentation: Queues an exact engine-synchronized transition to a pre-authored phase.

operations.name: dluma.quests.start
operations.documentation: Removed until a separately validated native start route exists.

operations.name: dluma.actions.run_chain
operations.documentation: Runs one exact active-map ActionChain after its native authored condition succeeds.

operations.name: dluma.actions.infection_flashback
operations.documentation: Requests one stock infection flashback for the current local player. Success acknowledges the request, not a rendered image. A failure after the native call may be uncertain; do not automatically retry or immediately request another effect.

operations.name: dluma.configuration.get
operations.documentation: Reads one typed player preference declared by the shared manifest.

operations.name: mod:on_config_changed
operations.documentation: Subscribes to copied changes for manifest-declared configuration.

operations.name: dluma.storage.get
operations.documentation: Reads one owner-isolated persistent scalar value.

operations.name: dluma.storage.set
operations.documentation: Persists one owner-isolated boolean, number, integer, or UTF-8 string.

operations.name: dluma.storage.delete
operations.documentation: Deletes one owner-isolated persistent scalar value.

operations.name: dluma.companion_content.open
operations.documentation: Opens one declared approval-bound companion artifact by canonical package-relative path.

operations.name: dluma.companion_content.read_entry
operations.documentation: Copies one canonical stored entry from an opened approval-bound companion archive.

operations.name: mod:handle_quest_phase
operations.documentation: Registers the primary callback for one handler declared by the calling mod manifest.

operations.name: mod:observe_quest_phase
operations.documentation: Registers an observer callback for one provider and handler contract ID.

operations.name: mod:off
operations.documentation: Idempotently unregisters one quest phase token owned by the calling mod.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.create
operations.documentation: Creates an owner-bound map-generation HUD surface.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.update
operations.documentation: Copies a complete RGBA8 frame synchronously.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.layout
operations.documentation: Sets a HUD rectangle in 1280 by 720 coordinates.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.visibility
operations.documentation: Shows or hides the owned HUD surface.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.suppress
operations.documentation: Sets the owner-controlled stock combat HUD suppression mask.

operations.name: dluma.ui_surface.release
operations.documentation: Releases an owned HUD surface and restores suppressed controls.

operations.name: dluma.hud.show
operations.documentation: Keeps the selected HUD element visible until this owner resets it. Hide requests from any owner take precedence. Targets accept health, stamina, radar, weapons, crosshair, reload, screen, an exact authored ID, or a slash-separated path from the screen root. An empty screen selects HUD.xui. IDs and path segments are case-sensitive; ambiguous targets are rejected. Overrides expire on map changes and owner unload.

operations.name: dluma.hud.hide
operations.documentation: Keeps the selected HUD element hidden until this owner resets it. Targets accept health, stamina, radar, weapons, crosshair, reload, screen, an exact authored ID, or a slash-separated path from the screen root. An empty screen selects HUD.xui. IDs and path segments are case-sensitive; ambiguous targets are rejected. Overrides expire on map changes and owner unload.

operations.name: dluma.hud.reset
operations.documentation: Removes this owner's visibility override and restores the latest visibility requested by the game. Targets accept health, stamina, radar, weapons, crosshair, reload, screen, an exact authored ID, or a slash-separated path from the screen root. An empty screen selects HUD.xui. IDs and path segments are case-sensitive; ambiguous targets are rejected. Overrides expire on map changes and owner unload.

operations.name: dluma.hud.set_position
operations.documentation: Submits a relative-position change for one uniquely selected authored XUI element. An empty screen selects HUD.xui. Success means the native call returned; game constraints can affect the value, and later game or animation updates can change it. An internal error means the UI may have changed; do not automatically retry.

operations.name: dluma.hud.set_opacity
operations.documentation: Immediately sets opacity on one uniquely selected authored XUI element. Later game or animation updates can change the value. An internal error means the UI may have changed; do not automatically retry.

operations.name: dluma.hud.set_color
operations.documentation: Immediately sets RGBA color on one uniquely selected authored IUIElementView. Other element types are rejected. Later game or animation updates can change the value. An internal error means the UI may have changed; do not automatically retry.

operations.name: dluma.hud.set_text_key
operations.documentation: Submits an ASCII localization key to one IUIText element using its existing localization callback. Success confirms submission, not that the key was found or displayed. An internal error means the UI may have changed; do not automatically retry.

operations.name: dluma.hud.start_animation
operations.documentation: Starts an authored named animation on one IUIElementTimeLine. The identifier must be printable ASCII and match the authored name. Success confirms engine acceptance, not visible playback. An internal error means the UI may have changed; do not automatically retry.

operations.name: dluma.hud.swap_document
operations.documentation: Requests an exclusive HUD document swap. Both files are project-relative data paths. Acceptance returns an owner-bound token; query its status to learn whether the swap was applied.

operations.name: dluma.hud.restore_document
operations.documentation: Requests restoration of an owner-bound HUD document swap. Acknowledgment is not restoration; query the request status.

operations.name: dluma.hud.document_status
operations.documentation: Returns an owner-bound document request. States: 1 preparing, 2 ready, 3 applying, 4 applied, 5 restoring, 6 restored, 7 failed, 8 recovery required, 9 release pending. Reasons: 0 none, 1 invalid, 2 busy, 3 unavailable, 4 source failed, 5 preflight failed, 6 scope lost, 7 load failed, 8 rollback failed, 9 release failed, 10 cancelled.

operations.name: dluma.hud.cancel_document
operations.documentation: Cancels a queued HUD document request or requests restoration if application has begun. Query status for the outcome.

operations.name: dluma.hud.swap_flashback_textures
operations.documentation: Requests replacement of eleven ordered flashback texture aliases. Acceptance returns an owner-bound token; query status for readiness and restoration.

operations.name: dluma.hud.flashback_texture_status
operations.documentation: Returns an owner-bound flashback texture request. States: 1 preparing, 2 ready, 3 active, 4 restoring, 5 stopped, 6 failed. Reasons: 0 none, 1 invalid, 2 not ready, 3 busy, 4 foreign, 5 stale, 6 retry. Ready means resources were prepared; it does not confirm changed pixels.

operations.name: dluma.hud.restore_flashback_textures
operations.documentation: Requests restoration of an owner-bound flashback texture request. Acknowledgment is not restoration; query status for the outcome.

operations.name: mod:handle
operations.documentation: Registers one owner-bound named mod handler.

operations.name: dluma.mod_handlers.invoke
operations.documentation: Invokes one named handler with JSON arguments and source context.

operations.name: mod:off
operations.documentation: Unregisters one handler owned by the calling mod.
